subject.title: Feature: Agent 动态切换命令（不重启 Gateway）

question: Should OpenClaw support a channel/session-scoped `/agent` command for configured agents, and what authorization policy should govern visible agents plus workspace/tool access?
rationale: The requested behavior crosses routing, channel commands, session state, workspace isolation, tool authorization, and credential boundaries, so automation should not choose the permanent security/product contract.

options.title: Design guarded session switch
options.body: Add a core-supported session override that lists and switches only among authorized configured agents while enforcing existing subagent, sandbox, and tool policy.

options.title: Keep static routing and focus commands
options.body: Decline direct configured-agent switching and keep bindings, TUI agent selection, `agents_list`, `sessions_spawn`, and `/focus` as the supported multi-agent paths.

options.title: Expose a plugin seam first
options.body: Define a generic agent-picker command/action SDK seam before any channel plugin exposes visible switch UI.

recommendation.title: Design guarded session switch
recommendation.body: Add a core-supported session override that lists and switches only among authorized configured agents while enforcing existing subagent, sandbox, and tool policy.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history signal for multi-agent routing and agent discovery points to steipete's merged feature work.
